contract:
SHARED FILE: B14 (tour + empty states, 'Pull to refresh later.' at :1484) and post edit (phone feed ⋯ menu :874, :1059, :1448, :2722) also edit this file. One owner at a time; land F5b after them or fold their edits into this batch.

- Org type (:56-65) gains: join_policy: JoinPolicy; audience: OrgAudience; join_state: JoinState; join_reason: 'policy'|'visiting'|null; pending_invite: {id: string; expires_at: string; invited_by_name: string|null} | null; role: OrgRole|null; pending_request?: boolean; viewer_follows?: boolean. New InviteRow type = /api/me/org-invites row {id, created_at, expires_at, org:{id,handle,name,logo_url,verified,audience}, invited_by:{name}|null}.
- refetchOrgs (:251-266) loads three lists in parallel, each with its own data + LoadFailure state: discover (unchanged URL and failure "Couldn't load orgs."), `/api/orgs?filter=following` (quiet, failure "Couldn't load the clubs you follow."), `/api/me/org-invites` (quiet, failure "Couldn't load your invites."). Keep viewerCampusId from the discover payload (orgs/route.ts:465-472).
- OrgsPane (:2311-2364) props become {discover, following, invites, errors, retry fns, viewerCampusId}. Discover null + error -> LoadFailed (today's behaviour); discover null -> PaneSkeleton. Sections in order, each with OrgSectionHeader (:2366): "You're invited" (invite rows) -> 'Yours' (following rows minus invited ids, server order) -> 'Verified' (discover verified minus ids above, alphabetical) -> 'All clubs' (rest, alphabetical; replaces 'All orgs'). A section whose list failed renders its header plus <LoadFailed failure onRetry> instead of rows; a section with no rows and no failure is omitted. 'Yours' never reads /api/orgs?filter=mine.
- Empty (discover ok, zero rows in every section, no section failed): <EmptyTab title='No clubs here yet' body={`Clubs are just getting started at ${campusName}. Follow the ones you like — their posts land in your feed.`} /> where campusName = campusRowById(viewerCampusId)?.name ?? 'your campus' (Indianapolis rows name 'Indianapolis'). Sparse (1-2 rows total): the same sentence as a muted footer line under the list. Replaces the title/body at :2323-2329; B14 must not ship a competing string for this pane.
- OrgRow (:2384-2493) restructure (no <button> inside <a>): outer <div> keeps the glass card styles; a next/link <Link href={`/orgs/${encodeURIComponent(handle)}`}> wraps ONLY the logo + text column; the chevron svg (:2468-2488) is removed. view = orgRowView(relation, 'phone_row'). Line 1: name, verified ✓, then view.chip as a pill ('Invited you' / 'Following'). Line 2 (discover/following rows): ['@' + handle, ...view.meta, memberCountText(member_count)] joined ' · '; invite rows: `@${handle} · Invited by ${invited_by?.name ?? 'an officer'}`. Line 3 only when view.disclosure: the text 'Officers can see who follows this club.' at 11.5px #8A8580, max 2 lines. view.layout 'slot': <OrgJoinControl variant='phone_row' source='discover'> in a right-side slot (flexShrink 0). layout 'line': the two controls render as a full-width row under the text inside the card, each flex:1, min-height 44, gap 8 — so on a 375px screen the name never truncates to fit two pills.
- Exactly what shows in each phone row (from orgRowView): member 'Joined ✓'; invited 'Accept' (Decline is on the org page); open club not followed 'Follow' + 'Join' on the action line; open club followed 'Following ✓' + 'Join'; request club not followed 'Follow'; request club followed 'Request' with chip 'Following'; requested / invite-only / audience-blocked / unverified 'Follow' or 'Following ✓'. Live SAE for a non-member: name 'SAE…' + ✓, '@sae · Invite only · 1 member', 'Officers can see who follows this club.', right slot 'Follow'.
- relation per row: discover/following rows {state: join_state, following: !!role || viewer_follows === true, role, reason: join_reason, audience, joinPolicy: join_policy, handle, orgName: name}, pendingInviteId = pending_invite?.id; invite rows {state:'invited', following:false, role:null, reason:null, audience: org.audience, joinPolicy:null}, pendingInviteId = row.id, logo = orgAssetProxyUrl(org.handle, org.logo_url, 'logo') (the inbox returns the raw key, me/org-invites/route.ts:114).
- onChange: store an override {state, following, role} keyed by org id for immediate paint, then re-run all three loads.
- SearchOrgRow (:3248-3337): meta line (:3331-3333) '@{handle}' + ' · Invite only' / ' · By request' + ' · IU only' / ' · Purdue only' only when those fields exist in the payload; still no control (search is navigate-first). SearchOrg type (:2899-2905) gains optional join_policy, audience.
- DO NOT TOUCH: the chat pane loader `/api/orgs?filter=mine` (:1505-1533), JoinedOrg (:1769-1777), OrgChannelsDrawer (:1833+), channels fetch (:1860).
acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint count not above HEAD.
`git diff` shows no change to the ChatPane loader, JoinedOrg, OrgChannelsDrawer or any '?filter=mine' string; Chat tab screenshot identical before/after for the SAE owner and for a non-member.
In the Orgs pane `document.querySelectorAll('a button, a a').length === 0`.

375x812 on production data as Franky (SAE owner): 'Yours' holds SAE with 'Joined ✓'. As a non-member test account: 'All clubs' (or 'Verified') holds SAE with '@sae · Invite only · 1 member', the disclosure line and 'Follow'.

375x812 with in-page overrides of the three loads: an invite row ('Invited you' chip, 'Invited by Franky', 'Accept'); an open club not followed (action line 'Follow' + 'Join' under the text, name not truncated); a request club followed ('Request' + 'Following' chip); a following-list failure showing "Couldn't load the clubs you follow." with Retry while the other sections render; zero clubs showing 'No clubs here yet' + 'Clubs are just getting started at Indianapolis. Follow the ones you like — their posts land in your feed.'

Tapping Follow on an overridden row sends POST /api/orgs/{handle}/follow {"source":"discover"} and then refetches discover, following and org-invites (network log). No agent-driven writes on production.
